notes:
I found two free drop-in options in Halton Hills. Both come from the operator's own page.

1. **EarlyON Child and Family Centres, Halton Hills (Links2Care).** 
These are free programs, activities and resources for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers.
 
They run on weekdays, weekends and evenings, and include drop-in programs.
 One listed location is 
the Acton Halton Hills Public Library, 17 River Street, Acton.
 Georgetown is also listed as a location. I only saw a snippet of their page, so I don't have a day or time.

2. **Kids & Me drop-in, Halton Hills Public Library Acton Branch (Halton Region Public Health).** 
This is a free weekly 1.5-hour drop-in for families with babies or children up to 6 years old.
 
The Acton Branch listing shows Thursdays from 1 p.m. to 2:30 p.m.
 
It follows the school calendar, starting the second week of September, and is closed over the December/January holidays, spring/summer breaks and statutory holidays.
 The page snippet began partway through its location list, so the Acton listing is worth a quick check.

I left out the Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre preschool drop-in because it costs $15. The library storytime listings I found were from an old calendar, so I couldn't confirm them for this fall.
